digest.component_or_area: semantic capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references exactly one declared packaging extra and one typed missing posture (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without importing its probe module.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain executable in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection emit actionable errors for error-posture capabilities.

Lean diagnostic and read-only modes (e.g., audit show, review/workflow diagnostics, status/check/dry-run) must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities, deferring enforcement until their respective boundaries.
Domain components retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry never manufactures their domain result or exception contract.
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot consume capability metadata and remain absent from the CLI route registry.
